changes.comment: Team creation no longer starts the TeamLeader's Agent Runtime. `team.create` without a `prompt` creates the Team and the leader identity and starts nothing; the runtime starts with the first message that reaches the leader (with a `prompt`, inside that first turn). This stops codex from opening a thread that never gets a turn and therefore never writes a rollout, which made the leader impossible to resume on the next start. A runtime that cannot start now surfaces on the first message's display instead of failing `team.create`.
